decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 5/4/2005, the detached outbuilding extension to rear of dwellinghouse measuring 12.0m projection, 6.0m wide and 4.0m high with a ridged roof, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and therefore does not require planning permission for the following reason: 
 
The proposed outbuilding does not cover more than 50% of the total area of the curtilage (excluding the ground area of the original dwelling house) and falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of single storey gym room in rear garden to house.
